wines.title: Sauvignon Blanc 2022
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold fermentation in stainless steel tanks.
The wine undergoes maceration in contact with the lees for six months in stainless steel tanks and is clarified through racking before bottling.
Tasting Notes

A beautiful straw-yellow hue with golden reflections, bright and elegant. It offers fresh aromas with notes of Eureka lemon, pineapple, tangerine, and white peach, complemented by delicate floral fragrances such as magnolia and orange blossom. On the palate, you’ll find hints of caramelized citrus, followed by a persistent floral finish that leaves a fresh and harmonious sensation.
Pairing
Perfect with fish and seafood, whether in carpaccio or ceviche, as well as pasta with creamy sauces, seafood pasta, mussels "à la marinière," and fresh oysters.
wines.packaging: Amber bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.title: Chardonnay 2022
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold fermentation in stainless steel tanks.
Malolactic fermentation takes place, followed by aging for 6 months in cold stainless steel tanks in contact with the lees for stabilization.
The wine is then aged for 6 months in second-use French oak barrels.
Clarification is achieved through racking.
Tasting Notes

Golden, bright, and crystalline, reflecting its elegance and freshness. Enveloping aromas of citrus such as orange, delicate notes of orange blossom, and a subtle hint of vanilla and butter, adding warmth and smoothness. Juicy flavors of orange, pineapple, and peach, complemented by a subtle note of vanilla, giving a silky and balanced finish.
Pairing
White fish tiradito with mint and dill, crème brûlée dessert, and/or fettuccine pasta.
wines.packaging: Amber bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting at dawn, followed by cold fermentation in stainless steel tanks.
Malolactic fermentation and aging for 6 months in stainless steel tanks at low temperatures, in contact with its lees for stabilization.
Tasting Notes

In this wine, we find bright lemon-yellow tones.
It has a medium-high intensity reminiscent of yellow lemon, tropical fruits such as kiwi and lychee, and white flowers like orange blossom.
On the palate, it presents a light alcohol content, with a moderate aftertaste featuring notes of yellow lemon, kiwi, and chamomile.
Pairing
Perfect to pair with dishes such as charcoal-grilled oysters, buttered lobster, and pasta with mussels.

wines.title: 1524 Espumoso Rosé 2022
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

Dos Búhos has created a Sparkling Rosé Brut.
Its salmon-pink color comes from a blend of Syrah, Tempranillo, and Cabernet Franc.
Short maceration in contact with the skins for less than 24 hours.
Made using the traditional Champenoise method, it remained in contact with its lees for 9 months.
Tasting Notes

This wine has a beautiful salmon-pink hue with copper highlights.
On the nose, it reveals delightful aromas of fresh strawberries, peach, red apple, and delicate rose petals.
On the palate, we find flavors of strawberries, roses, and cranberries, with a citrus touch of grapefruit and a bright acidity.
Pairing
Ideal to pair with desserts such as strawberries with chocolate, smoked peaches with Camembert cheese, or even Linguine pasta with beetroot or tuna sashimi.
wines.packaging: Transparent bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.title: Espontáneo Pet-Nat 2023
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold fermentation in stainless steel tanks.
Malolactic fermentation occurs, and the wine is aged for 6 months in cold stainless steel tanks in contact with its lees for stabilization.
An ancestral method is used, initiating a second fermentation in the bottle, resulting in our Pet Nat with bubbles.
Tasting Notes

With a light golden yellow color, reflecting gold and amber, the wine offers intense and expressive aromas with notes of exotic fruits such as lychee, kiwi, yellow and white peach, starfruit, and pineapple, accompanied by a subtle hint of orange blossom. On the palate, it is vibrant and citrusy, evolving into enveloping flavors of caramel, honey, acacia flower, and crystallized lemon.
Pairing
Perfect to pair with fish ceviche with mango, golden sashimi with ginger and lime blossom, vegetable tempura, battered shrimp, and lemon tiramisu.
wines.packaging: Amber bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.title: Espontáneo Anaranjado 2023
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold fermentation in stainless steel tanks.
Alcoholic fermentation with native yeasts takes place in stainless steel tanks.
Maceration lasts for 6 months in stainless steel tanks with skins and seeds.
Aging occurs in second-use French oak barrels for 12 months on its lees.
Clarification is achieved through racking.
Tasting Notes

With a beautiful orange hue and ochre reflections, it presents delicate aromas of crystallized Japanese orange, accompanied by citrus notes, magnolia flower, and a subtle hint of honey. It has a dry character that highlights the citrus, but with the juiciness of a freshly bitten mandarin directly from the tree. Its persistence on the palate is exceptional.
Pairing
Ideal for Japanese cuisine, fish sushi, sashimi, or tempura-fried dishes. It has enough character to pair with savory dishes, and it goes wonderfully with paella.
wines.packaging: Amber bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.title: Mosaico 2022
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We carry out manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold maceration for 24 hours, with manual pumpovers three times a day to extract maximum flavor and color.
After fermentation, we leave the wine in post-fermentation maceration for 7 days to achieve greater complexity.
Finally, it ages for 12 months in first-use French oak barrels, refining through a natural clarification process by racking.
Tasting Notes

This wine has a red-violet hue with enveloping aromas of apple, raspberry, and blueberry, complemented by subtle spicy notes of clove and cinnamon, and a delightful touch of dark chocolate. It has intense flavors of spices, wood, and black fruits, with a slight smoky note that adds depth and character.
Pairing
BBQ ribs, grilled sea bass, cold cuts pizza, and it can even be paired with apple strudel.
wines.packaging: Amber bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

We perform manual harvesting in the early morning, followed by cold maceration for 24 hours, with manual punchdowns three times a day to extract maximum flavor and color. After fermentation, the wine is left in post-fermentation maceration for 7 days to achieve greater complexity. Finally, it ages for 12 months in new American oak barrels, refining through a natural clarification process by racking.
Tasting Notes

It has beautiful purple tones, clean and bright.
With delightful aromas of red fruits such as cherry, blueberry, pomegranate, flowers like hibiscus and violet, we can also find spicy notes like black pepper and clove, finishing with oak notes such as bitter chocolate, smoke, and leather.
On the palate, we can confirm its aromatic complexity, highlighting hibiscus, cherry, and bitter chocolate.
Pairing
This wine is perfect to pair with dishes such as confit duck with a red fruit sauce, crispy cochinita pibil tacos with purple onion, smoked pork in hibiscus sauce, or BBQ ribs.

wines.title: 1524 Montepulciano
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

For this wine, we follow a traditional fortification process by adding grappa before the must finishes fermentation, preserving the residual sugar characteristic of this wine style.
We hand-harvest in the early morning.
Aged for 2 years in first-use Hungarian oak barrels.
Tasting Notes

A deep ruby-red hue with bright copper reflections.
Aromas of caramel, dark chocolate, vanilla, anise, blackberry, and plum jam, along with floral hints of roses and violets.
On the palate, it is sweet, with flavors of caramel and black fruit preserves.
Pairing
Traditionally enjoyed with desserts like tiramisu or crème brûlée. For a unique experience, it pairs beautifully with dishes like enmoladas, pipián, or even aged cheeses for a delightful contrast.

wines.title: 1524 Vin d’Orange Amères
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

A bitter wine inspired by the style of southern France, ideal as a digestif to extend the after-dinner conversation and savor every moment.
Crafted from our rosé wine, macerated with oranges for three months, and fortified with a touch of vodka.
Tasting Notes

An elegant salmon-rose hue with orange reflections, evoking the warmth of sunset.
Fresh and vibrant citrus aromas, featuring notes of orange and grapefruit, accompanied by a subtle floral hint that adds delicacy and balance.
Intense and refreshing flavors, marked by the liveliness of bitter citrus. Its dry and bright profile envelops the palate, leaving a fresh and persistent sensation that invites continued enjoyment.
Pairing
Perfect for crafting cocktails like a spritz, pairing with oyster and seafood platters, or even a red berry parfait.
wines.packaging: Transparent bottle 750ml – Agglomerated cork – Box of 12 bottles.

wines.title: 1524 Vermouth
wines.place:
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, México.
Valle de la Independencia.
sections: Winemaking Process

Made from our Tempranillo red wine base, macerated with 32 spices during fermentation for 15 days.
It is then aged in second-use French oak barrels.
Tasting Notes

A brilliant, clean, and crisp ruby-red hue.
Intense spiced aromas such as star anise, clove, wormwood, and cinnamon.
On the palate, a blend of spices and fruitiness unfolds, featuring notes of cherry, hibiscus, blackberry, cinnamon, cardamom, black pepper, clove, and anise.
Pairing
Ideal for Negroni preparation, though traditionally enjoyed as a digestif served over ice with an orange peel.
